notes.headline: The champs start among the favorites, and K-Ville bought its way to the top
notes.dek: Week 1 tips off Tuesday, Oct 20. Here's how the 12 rosters stack up on paper, who made the big offseason moves, and what to watch in the opening matchups.
notes.byline: Written from Fantrax projections and this offseason's transactions.

storylines.title: Guangdong is still a problem
storylines.body: The defending champs project first in points and rebounds and second in 3s and assists. On paper they beat 9 of the other 11 teams in a weekly matchup. Their weak spot is turnovers, where they project last.

storylines.title: K-Ville went all in
storylines.body: K-Ville sent six players, a 2027 1st and two 2026 1sts to Next UP: Zach Babies for Kevin Durant, James Harden, Kawhi Leonard, Dillon Brooks and Grayson Allen. They now project first in 3s, FT%, assists and steals, and first overall.

storylines.title: Zach Babies are playing the long game
storylines.body: Last year's 10–7 team now holds five 2027 1sts and projects last in five categories. Expect their veterans to be available to anyone chasing a title.

storylines.title: Team OD wants the one that got away
storylines.body: OD went 15–2 last regular season and lost the final. They project second in steals and in the middle of the pack overall, and open as underdogs against Shanghai.

storylines.title: The big-man builds
storylines.body: Competing God and Blocktopus Prime project top two in both FG% and blocks and in the bottom half in 3s and assists. They'll win the paint and give away the perimeter most weeks.

matchups.070oazg4mqqv88in_b33iacngmqqv88in: Opening-week headliner: the champs against the league's best shot-blocking team. It projects 5–4 Blocktopus, winning FG%, FT%, steals, blocks and turnovers while Guangdong takes 3s, points, rebounds and assists.
matchups.mizl2op8mqqv88im_cipchrpimqqv88in: Shanghai projects 6–3. OD's path is steals, blocks and turnovers, plus one more.
matchups.ctvglb6gmqqv88in_xoe774vlmqqv88in: K-Ville's new veterans debut against eweiss35 and project a comfortable 7–2. eweiss's best shots are FG% and rebounds.
matchups.ygisq4rlmqqv88in_rufupenmmqqv88in: Projects 5–4 Competing God in a matchup of opposites: LeBrown James takes 3s, FT%, assists and turnovers, Competing God the big-man categories.
matchups.n3z2eshxmqqv88in_saydaqzgmqqv88in: West Palm Salon projects 7–2 against a Zach Babies roster built for 2027.
matchups.auysoygrmqqv88in_d91prsm4mqqv88in: A matchup of two rebuilding teams. Presti's depth makes them 7–2 favorites.

bruno.auysoygrmqqv88in: Flagg, Peterson, Wagler, Ace Bailey and Stephon Castle all hit their mid-20s around 2030, with Anthony Edwards still in his prime. No roster has more young talent peaking at the same time.
bruno.d91prsm4mqqv88in: Presti drafted a whole backcourt: Harper, Demin, Acuff, Mikel Brown, Caleb Wilson and Fears, plus Jalen Johnson in his prime. If two of the kids become stars, they can pass both teams above them.
bruno.070oazg4mqqv88in: The champs barely fade. Doncic is 31 in 2030 and Barnes and Holmgren are still in their primes. The only team in the top three both today and in 2030–31.
bruno.b33iacngmqqv88in: Wembanyama projects as the most valuable player in the league in 2030–31, by a lot. The question is depth: the roster around him has to keep pace for this to become a dynasty.
bruno.saydaqzgmqqv88in: AJ Dybantsa plus three 2027 1sts is a strong base. The model only counts picks it can see, so a good 2027 draft could push them into the top three.
bruno.mizl2op8mqqv88im: Shai keeps them dangerous through the decade, but the roster around him ages fast. Their projected strength drops every season after this one, so the window is now.
bruno.ygisq4rlmqqv88in: The flattest line in the league. Maxey and Collin Murray-Boyles keep them steady, but the 2026 rookie class didn't add a future star.
bruno.xoe774vlmqqv88in: All in on right now, and it shows: first today, eighth by 2030–31 as Jokic, Durant, Harden and Kawhi age out.
bruno.cipchrpimqqv88in: Amen Thompson and Dyson Daniels are a strong defensive base, but Curry, Jaylen Brown, Irving and Holiday will be on the back nine by 2030.
bruno.rufupenmmqqv88in: Cameron Boozer is a real centerpiece. The rest of the top of the roster (Davis, Embiid, Gobert, Lillard) will be well into their 30s, so they need a second young star.
bruno.ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Booker, Giannis and Brunson make them dangerous today, but nobody under 25 projects as a 2030 starter and they hold no 2027 picks.
bruno.n3z2eshxmqqv88in: Five 2027 1sts, but almost no young players yet. The model can only see one draft class of picks, so expect this ranking to climb fast once those picks turn into players.
